claim_ceiling: The register identifies candidate legal/standards pathways and source states. It does not determine applicability or authorize a project, product, contractor, or site.

sources.name: National Building Regulations and Building Standards Act 103 of 1977
sources.known_position: National building-control statutory anchor. Project duties depend on current regulations, use, scope, jurisdiction and applicable standards.
required_checks: Confirm current amended Act text at project decision date
Map relevant National Building Regulations and current SANS 10400 parts to building use, height, occupancy and project type
Obtain municipal building-plan, inspection and occupation evidence where required
sources.scope: Building works and standards pathway; applicability must be determined for each project

sources.name: SANS 10400 series
sources.known_position: The applicable parts/editions and amendments must be confirmed from SABS for each building use and system. Standards are copyrighted; do not redistribute their text without rights.
required_checks: Check current edition and amendments directly with SABS
Map each applicable part to a requirement and system/product revision
Record lawful access/licence and edition date; do not infer from a secondary summary

sources.name: SANS 10400-XA energy usage in buildings
sources.known_position: SAIAT's professional CPD portal identifies SANS 10400-XA:2026 Edition 3 and says it was published early in 2026, noting a change to the method for satisfying energy-efficient hot-water requirements. This is specialist secondary evidence, not a substitute for the SABS catalogue or copyrighted standard. The exact SABS publication metadata, effective/transition dates, full text and project applicability have not been independently verified. Do not treat Edition 2 (2021) as the latest edition.
required_checks: Retrieve the exact SABS catalogue record for SANS 10400-XA:2026 Edition 3 and confirm its approval/publication date, status, effective date and any transition arrangements
Acquire and review the official standard under lawful access; do not reconstruct copyrighted clause text from secondary summaries
Compare Edition 3 with Edition 2 and verify all changes, including the hot-water compliance route identified by SAIAT
Confirm applicable occupancy/building classes, compliance route and project/municipal treatment with the responsible qualified person and authority
Bind calculations, equipment/product declarations, source/weather inputs and professional responsibility to the exact project and design revision

latest_edition_evidence.reported_change_focus: method for satisfying energy-efficient hot-water requirements
latest_edition_evidence.source_quality: specialist_secondary_source; presenter identified as chair of SABS TC060 and member of the latest review workgroup

sources.name: Agrément South Africa certification
sources.known_position: Agrément describes fitness-for-purpose evaluation of non-standardised construction products, materials and systems against performance criteria, with assessment of the applicant's quality system.
required_checks: Check certificate status, holder/licensee, technical scope, exclusions, expiry and conditions
Match exact product/system, material, factory/process and installation configuration
Check whether proposed substitutions or site/design changes invalidate applicability
sources.scope: Non-standardised products/materials/systems; not automatic building-plan approval or universal project approval

sources.name: Agrément performance criteria review for building, walling systems and products
sources.known_position: Published notice says criteria covering structural strength/stability/serviceability, fire, water penetration/damp, acoustics, thermal/energy/condensation, durability and technical-drawing guidance were under review with a target completion date of 31 October 2026. The notice itself does not prove that a revised criteria version was issued.
required_checks: Obtain written/current criteria version from Agrément
Record effective date and transition rules
Do not treat the target date as proof of publication or apply an assumed revised edition

sources.name: NHBRC registration, enrolment and Home Building Manual requirements
sources.known_position: NHBRC requirements may apply to covered homebuilding activity. Applicability and current manual/technical requirements need to be checked for each housing project and participant.
required_checks: Check current Act, enrolment requirements and exemptions with NHBRC
Verify builder registration and project enrolment where applicable
Bind inspection/defect/repair obligations and exact homebuilding scope
sources.scope: Residential homebuilding; not automatically applicable to every non-residential asset

sources.name: NHBRC Innovative Building Technologies dynamic database
sources.known_position: NHBRC publishes downloadable dynamic IBT database spreadsheets and states that it is researching structural performance of registered innovative building systems because performance information is limited. A database entry is not blanket approval of every design, site, application, installer or revision.
required_checks: Download and hash the database snapshot used for a project decision
Verify status, system, holder, conditions and scope with NHBRC
Check project-specific structural, fire, durability and municipal evidence; no transfer to altered system configurations
sources.scope: Innovative building technology register; project-specific requirements remain

sources.name: Occupational Health and Safety Act and Construction Regulations
sources.known_position: The Department published draft Construction Regulations 2025 for comment, intended to replace Construction Regulations 2014. The draft/final operative status and commencement must be verified from official gazette/legal sources at the date of work.
required_checks: Determine current in-force regulations and amendments
Check construction work permit/notification thresholds and responsible appointments for project scope
Require site-specific risk assessments and task/human-robot system risk assessment
Do not treat draft 2025 text as operative law

sources.name: CBE Public Interest and Safety Regulations announced with National Built Environment and Construction Safety Framework
sources.publisher: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure / Council for the Built Environment
sources.known_position: The minister announced that regulations would be gazetted, focusing on structural/dolomitic occurrences, construction compliance and competency certification aligned to SANS 17024. The launch announcement is not a gazette or proof of commencement.
required_checks: Find and verify actual gazette number, text, effective date and transition if promulgated
Until verified, do not state that the announced regulations are operative
Map only after publication and scope analysis
sources.scope: Professional competence and built-environment safety if/when made operative

sources.name: cidb construction procurement prescripts
sources.known_position: cidb states that its prescripts govern public-sector construction procurement; Treasury regulations also apply. The exact operative prescript/version must be captured for the procuring institution, contract type and decision date.
required_checks: Record client type, infrastructure procurement scope and governing statutes
Identify exact operative Standard for Uniformity and amendments
Check PFMA/MFMA, applicable Treasury instructions, cidb regulations and institutional policy
Do not treat a draft standard as operative
sources.scope: Public-sector infrastructure procurement; not all private-sector goods/services

sources.name: Public Procurement Act 28 of 2024
sources.publisher: Republic of South Africa / Constitutional Court
sources.known_position: In Premier of the Western Cape Government and Another v Speaker of the National Assembly and Others; City of Cape Town and Others v Speaker of the National Assembly and Others, [2026] ZACC 37, the Constitutional Court declared the Act invalid for failure to facilitate public involvement. The order was not suspended; the judgment says the Act had not been brought into operation and existing legislation continued to govern.
required_checks: Do not treat the 2024 Act as operative law
Use the judgment and current PFMA/MFMA/PPPFA/cidb framework relevant to the procurement, verified at decision date
Check for subsequent constitutionally compliant replacement legislation
sources.scope: Public procurement framework; project-specific law and prescripts remain

sources.name: Draft second edition of Standard for Uniformity in Construction Procurement (BN 986, Gazette 55409)
sources.known_position: A further draft second-edition notice was published in Gazette 55409 on 18 September 2026, after the July 2026 draft. The cidb page still also surfaces the July notice; the later draft follows the Constitutional Court's 17 September 2026 invalidation of the Public Procurement Act 2024. No final operative second-edition standard has been verified here.
required_checks: Retrieve the exact Gazette 55409 notice and draft text
Resolve the actual consultation process/deadline and legal basis from the official notice and cidb
Wait for final operative publication and commencement before treating as prescript
Use currently operative prescripts for actual procurement

sources.name: cidb B.U.I.L.D programme standards
sources.known_position: cidb says the B.U.I.L.D standards were revised on 31 March 2026 and apply to qualifying infrastructure projects. The relevant project threshold, grade and scope must be checked rather than assumed.
required_checks: Verify current standard version and effective date
Check project value/type/grade thresholds and applicable client
Bind the applicable standard and audit evidence to the contract

sources.name: City of Johannesburg land-use, building-plan, inspection and occupation approvals
sources.known_position: Municipal planning/building-control requirements depend on land use, location, building class/use and submission context. The correct municipal process and current bylaws/forms must be verified for each site.
required_checks: Confirm zoning/land-use rights and conditions
Confirm applicable building-control submission and current forms
Retain building-plan decision, inspections and occupation certificate evidence where required
Map roads/reserves/public-space permits separately

sources.name: Environmental authorisation, water-use, waste, heritage and land permissions
sources.known_position: Requirements are activity-, site- and resource-dependent. The inventory must not assume every permit applies or infer NotApplicable without a documented screening rationale.
required_checks: Screen listed activities and environmental triggers
Check National Water Act/water-use requirements where relevant
Check waste licences/permits and lawful recovery destinations
Check heritage/road reserve/public-space permissions where relevant

global_rules: A press release, target date or consultation notice is not evidence of an operative law or final standard.
A standard's existence is not proof of product conformity.
A product certificate does not automatically transfer to a different system, factory, material, installer, site or design revision.
Draft, operative, superseded, invalidated, announced, expired, revoked and unknown must remain distinct.
SANS standards text is copyrighted; record identifiers, edition, scope and lawful access, but do not redistribute text without rights.
Every real project requires applicability screening by qualified professionals and the relevant authority.
